purpose: Art-direction proposals only; no runtime replacement

variants.name: A-ballpark
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a landscape art-direction concept image for the pixel-art video game EVOLUTION WARS. This is a style proposal, not a working screenshot. Reference image 1 shows current layout and existing commentators; discard its generic dark-blue boxes, orange hazard stripes and ugly opponent plate. Reference image 2 is the approved Nico portrait: preserve his odd friendly face, thinning hair, glasses, mustard shirt, age and consistent pixel size. Do not make him handsome. Keep the two original commentators recognizably as reference, small at top center. No self portrait.
Use exactly the same comparison layout: upper left Nico identity with name "NICO VALDÉS" and small "LEVEL 01"; top center two commentators; below them a long horizontal PHYSICAL outdoor stadium dot-matrix message sign; below this, upper portion of an abstract dark rink with orange and cyan agent dots, plus compact three-card ACTIVE CARDS racks at left and right. Important the cards are actual small vertical collectible playing cards, rounded corners, illustrated central icons, layered paper edges, readable short titles TURN, THRUST, DIRECTION, costs 1,2,3 as illustrative samples only. All three cards fully readable, no flat list rows. Right rack has a modest "CHANGE CARDS" affordance suggesting a deck overlay. Use orange #F58B23 ONLY as opponent identity/team color and its agents, cyan #24D0FF for our side/agents. Neutral card illustration colors, no behavior-based dot colors. Sign text "NICO 95%   /   YOU 98%" in fixed lit dots. Mechanical supports, small maintenance ladder on side of sign, three-dimensional depth from pixel shadows, rain hood, outdoor floodlights, subtle wear. This should be distinctive and welcoming. Physical stadium atmosphere even though field is an abstract simulation. Keep scenery secondary; visible framing does not consume most of the screen. Clear controlled pixel clusters, consistent pixel-art scale, no blurry textures or photorealism. No hazard stripes, tiny techno UI outlines, gold fantasy filigree, construction-site aesthetic, generic software dashboards, red opposing team. Big expressive funky readable display typography, simple readable small type. Show a small corner concept label. A / BALLPARK. Green-and-cream old ballpark scoreboard, worn forest-green painted metal and softly rounded corners, sturdy cream sign letters in chunky friendly sign-painter/block lettering inspired by Bungee. Subtle steel catwalk and ladder make it unmistakably an outdoor structure. Nico identity a charming vintage baseball collectible card with clipped paper name pennant, not orange industrial plate. Active action cards resemble old illustrated sports trading cards: cream stock, forest green backing, clean ink illustration. Modest orange corner tabs only on Nico side, blue tabs our side. Strong warm sporting character. Not literal Wrigley branding.
